Koncept Extension 104

    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CompositeKonceptDefinitionSource
    A definition source that chains multiple sources in priority order.
    EmptyParagraphPostprocessor
    AsciidoctorJ postprocessor that removes empty paragraph blocks from the generated HTML.
    FrontBackMatterTreeprocessor
    Tags level-1 special sections so the print stylesheets can route them to front- or back-matter page schemes instead of the chapter scheme.
    IdenticonRenderer
    Renders the Komet identicon for a koncept as a PNG.
    KonceptBadgeAnatomyBlockMacro
    AsciidoctorJ block macro that renders the anatomy of a Koncept Badge as a real, captioned figure: the referenced koncept's badge — kind sigil, identicon, name — drawn large, with a muted part label beneath each part.
    KonceptDefinition
    Immutable definition of a Koncept, including natural language definition, description logic axiom, and optional terminology identifiers.
    KonceptDefinition.Builder
    Builder for constructing KonceptDefinition instances from parsed YAML or programmatic sources.
    KonceptDefinition.ModelFeature
    One Model Feature of a kind: pattern koncept in presentation form: the referenced component first, then each declared field, labeled 1-indexed (Field 1 is the first declared field).
    KonceptDefinition.PatternField
    One field of a kind: pattern koncept: its own meaning, purpose, and data-type koncept identifiers, in the pattern's own declared field order.
    KonceptDefinition.RetiredComment
    A comment's text immediately before it was retired, and the time of that retirement.
    KonceptDefinitionSource
    Strategy interface for resolving Koncept definitions.
    KonceptEntry
    Tracks references to a single Koncept within a document.
    KonceptExtensionRegistry
    SPI entry point for automatic registration of Koncept extensions with AsciidoctorJ.
    KonceptGlossaryProcessor
    AsciidoctorJ postprocessor that generates a "Referenced Koncepts" glossary section and a colophon at the end of the document.
    KonceptGlossaryTreeprocessor
    Builds a real, TOC-visible AST section for the comprehensive (koncept-glossary-all) glossary mode (IKE-Network/ike-issues#877).
    KonceptIdenticonFigureBlockMacro
    AsciidoctorJ block macro that renders a koncept's identicon as a real, captioned figure — for prose that talks about identicons (a "How to Read This Guide" front matter) and needs to show one at figure size, not badge size.
    KonceptInlineMacro
    AsciidoctorJ inline macro processor that handles k:ConceptName[] syntax in AsciiDoc documents.
    KonceptNarrativeBlockMacro
    AsciidoctorJ block macro processor that splices a koncept's curated, long-form narrative field into the document as real AsciiDoc source.
    KonceptPatternListBlockMacro
    AsciidoctorJ block macro processor that renders a "List of Patterns": a flat, numbered index of every kind: pattern koncept in the definition source, alphabetical by label, each entry a plain link to that pattern's own entry in the Koncept Glossary — no columns, no icons, styled the same as the document's own table of contents (ul.sectlevel1) rather than as a data table.
    KonceptPatternTableBlockMacro
    AsciidoctorJ block macro processor that renders a kind: pattern koncept's shape as a real, captioned AsciiDoc table — one Model Feature (the referenced component, then each declared field in order) per three-row group (IKE-Network/ike-issues#883).
    KonceptSigilInlineMacro
    AsciidoctorJ inline macro that renders a component-kind sigil on its own — the mark a Koncept Badge carries for its kind, without any badge around it — so prose that talks about the sigil scheme (a "How to Read This Guide" front matter, a tutorial) can show the real marks instead of describing them.
    KonceptSvgRenderer
    Generates inline SVG badge markup for Koncept references.
    KonceptTreeBlockProcessor
    AsciidoctorJ block processor that renders a [koncept-tree] delimited block as an indented list of Koncept chips — the print/HTML/e-mail projection of the live tree Komet draws in the assistant surface (IKE-Network/ike-issues#827, the static counterpart of #805).
    SnomedUuids
    Derives the Tinkar PublicId UUID for a SNOMED CT concept from its SCTID.
    YamlKonceptDefinitionSource
    Loads Koncept definitions from a YAML file.
